relationships.subject: alpha-band event-related desynchronization
relationships.evidence_quote: the α-ERD duration significantly mediated the effect of stimulus duration on subjective pain ratings

relationships.subject: low-frequency component
relationships.evidence_quote: These 2 sustained brain responses were highly coupled, with the α-oscillation amplitude that fluctuated with the LFC phase.

key_findings: Two sustained EEG responses (insula/ACC low-frequency component and sensorimotor alpha-ERD) track stimulus duration and are serially coupled in translating nociception into pain perception.
